chapter: Opening and the New York trip
title: Chicago, then a New Orleans jazz band's trip to New York
summary: Garland went straight to Chicago, then played bass in a New Orleans band with Keppard, Sugar Johnny, Duhe and Lindsay; the drummer missed the train so they played without drums and worked a show and a club in New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene
